title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Change and Conversion Parameters
content:
After a Mortgage Pre-Approval is issued, its level governs how far the largest supported purchase price may be raised without re-running the approval, what fall in credit score counts as a material change, how the approval carries into a loan application, and how long after a decline a new request waits. The parameters for each level are:

| Level | Raising the largest purchase price requires the approval to be re-run | Largest raise allowed without re-running the approval (percent) | Credit score fall counting as a material change (points) | Approval honored at application when no material change occurred | Credit report reused when the pre-approval converts to an application | Calendar days after a decline before a new request is taken without new information |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | No | 10.00 | 40 | No | No | 30 |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | No | 5.00 | 40 | No | Yes | 30 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | Yes | 0.00 | 20 | No | Yes | 30 |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | 0.00 | 20 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | 0.00 | 20 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Yes | 0.00 | 20 | Yes | Yes | 30 |

## Parameter definitions

1. **Re-run on raise**: whether raising the largest supported purchase price requires the approval to be re-run.
2. **Largest raise without re-run**: the largest raise of the largest supported purchase price allowed without re-running the approval, in percent to two decimals.
3. **Material change credit score fall**: the fall in credit score that counts as a material change voiding an underwritten approval, in whole points.
4. **Approval honored at application**: whether the approval is honored at application when no material change occurred.
5. **Credit report reuse at conversion**: whether the credit report is reused when the pre-approval converts to an application.
6. **Re-request period after a decline**: the calendar days after a decline before a new request is taken without new information.

## Notes

- The Larkspur Pre-Qualification allows a raise of up to 10.00 percent without re-running the approval, and the Larkspur Pre-Approval up to 5.00 percent; the four remaining levels require the approval to be re-run for any raise, and their figure is 0.00 percent.
- The material-change credit score fall is 40 points at the Larkspur Pre-Qualification and Pre-Approval and 20 points at the other four levels.
- The approval is honored at application when no material change occurred at the Larkspur Underwritten, Jumbo Underwritten and Lock & Shop Pre-Approvals only.
- The Larkspur Pre-Qualification is the one level whose credit report is not reused at conversion.
- The re-request period after a decline is 30 calendar days at every level.

Illustration on a hypothetical price: under a Larkspur Pre-Approval with a largest supported purchase price of USD 400,000, the largest raise allowed without re-running the approval is 5.00 percent of that price, which is USD 20,000, to a price of USD 420,000.
